sanskrit: yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmas tasya prāṇān saṃ vṛha tasya prāṇān vi vṛha ||
english: He who hates us and whom we hate — compress his breaths, scatter his breaths.

sanskrit: indro 'sīndrasya rūpam asi prajāpatir asi parameṣṭhy asi ||
english: You are Indra, you are the form of Indra; you are Prajāpati, you are Parameṣṭhin.

sanskrit: svar asi svargo 'si svargaloko 'si svargaṃ mā lokaṃ gamaya ||
english: You are the sun-realm, you are heaven, you are the heavenly world; lead me to the heavenly world.

sanskrit: yenāsya vahas tena yajño yena vahati tena lokaḥ ||
english: By that by which it carries this one, by that is the sacrifice; by that by which it carries, by that is the world.

sanskrit: yenainaṃ paśyati tena viśvo yenainaṃ gamayati tena sarvaḥ ||
english: By that by which it sees this one, by that it is the all; by that by which it conveys this one, by that it is the whole.

sanskrit: ye 'sya pādāḥ sā pratiṣṭhā | prati tiṣṭhati prajayā paśubhir gṛhair dhanena ya evaṃ vidvān anaḍuho vrataṃ bibharti ||
english: Its feet are its foundation. He who, knowing this, upholds the vow of the bull-ox becomes established with offspring, with cattle, with houses, with wealth.

sanskrit: naḍam ā roha na te atra loka idaṃ sīsaṃ bhāgadheyaṃ ta ehi | yo goṣu yakṣmaḥ puruṣeṣu yakṣmas tena tvaṃ sākam adharāṅ parehi ||
english: Mount the reed; there is no world for you here — this lead is your allotted share, come hither. Whatever disease is in cattle, whatever disease is in men — with that, go down together to the nether regions.

sanskrit: aghaśaṃsaduḥśaṃsau kareṇānukareṇa ca | mṛtyūṃś ca sarvāṃs teneto yakṣmāṃś ca nir ajāmasi ||
english: Evil-proclaimer and ill-proclaimer, along with the female elephant and the she-elephant — all deaths and diseases too we drive away from here with this.

sanskrit: nir ito mṛtyuṃ nirṛtiṃ nir yakṣmam ajāmasi | yo no dveṣṭi tam addhy agne kravyād yaṃ dviṣmas taṃ te pra suvāmaḥ ||
english: From here we drive away death, decay, and disease. O flesh-eating Agni, devour him who hates us; him whom we hate, we press forward to you.

sanskrit: yady agniḥ kravyād yadi vā vyāghra imaṃ goṣṭham anyokā ā viveśa | taṃ māṣājyaṃ kṛtvā pra hiṇomi dūraṃ sa gacchatv apsuṣado 'ty agnīn ||
english: If the flesh-eating fire or a tiger, lodging elsewhere, has entered this cattle-pen — making an offering of beans and ghee I send him far away; let him who sits in the waters go beyond the fires.

sanskrit: yat tvā kuddhāḥ pracakrur manyunā puruṣe mṛte | sukalpam agne tat tvayā punas tvod dīpayāmasi ||
english: What angry men, in their wrath, made of you at the death of a man — that which is well-formed, O Agni, we kindle you with that anew.

sanskrit: punas tvādityā rudrā vasavaḥ punar brahmā vasunītir agre | punas tvā brahmaṇaspatir ādhād dīrghāyutvāya śataśāradāya ||
english: The Ādityas, the Rudras, the Vasus restore you; Brahman, the guide of good things, restores you in the beginning. Bṛhaspati has established you anew for long life, for a hundred autumns.

sanskrit: yo agniḥ kravyāt praviveśa vo gṛham imaṃ paśyann itaraṃ jātavedasam | taṃ harāmi pitṛyajñāya dūraṃ sa gharmam indhat parame sadhasthe ||
english: That flesh-eating fire who has entered your house, beholding this other Jātavedas — him I carry away far for the sacrifice to the fathers; let him kindle the hot milk-offering at the highest resting-place.

sanskrit: kravyādam agniṃ pra hiṇomi dūraṃ yamarājño gacchatu ripravāhaḥ | ihaivāyam itaro jātavedā devo devebhyo havyaṃ vahatu prajānan ||
english: The flesh-eating fire I send far away; let him, the bearer of filth, go to the realm of King Yama. Let this other Jātavedas remain here — the god, knowing, shall carry the oblation to the gods.

sanskrit: kravyādam agnim iṣito harāmi janān druhantaṃ vajreṇa mṛtyum | vi taṃ śāsmi gārhapatyena vidvān pitṝṇāṃ loke api bhāgo asya ||
english: Being urged, I carry away the flesh-eating fire, death that harms people, with the thunderbolt. Knowing, I separate him by means of the Gārhapatya fire; his share is in the world of the fathers.

sanskrit: kravyādam agniṃ śasamānam ukthyaṃ pra hiṇomi pathibhiḥ pitṛyāṇaiḥ | mā devayānaiḥ pathibhir ā gā atraivaidhi pitṛṣu jāgṛhi tvam ||
english: The flesh-eating fire, worthy of praise-verses though praising slaughter, I send forth along the paths that lead to the fathers. Do not come back by the god-faring paths — stay here, be awake among the fathers.

sanskrit: sam indhate saṃkasukaṃ svastaye śuddhā bhavantaḥ śucayaḥ pāvakāḥ | jahāti ripram aty ena eti samiddho agniḥ supunā punāti ||
english: They kindle the saṃkasuka for well-being, becoming pure, bright, and purifying. He abandons defilement and passes beyond it — the kindled Agni, cleansing well, purifies.

sanskrit: devo agniḥ saṃkasuko divas pṛṣṭhāny āruhat | mucyamāno nir aṃhaso mohyāsmām̐ aśastyāḥ ||
english: The divine Agni Saṃkasuka has climbed the back of heaven. Being freed from distress, free us also from ill-repute.

sanskrit: asmin vayaṃ saṃkasuke agne riprāṇi mṛjmahe | abhūma yajñiyāḥ śuddhāḥ pra ṇa āyūṃṣi tāriṣat ||
english: In you, O Agni Saṃkasuka, we wipe away our impurities. We have become fit for sacrifice, purified — extend our life-spans forward.

sanskrit: saṃkasuko vikasuko nirṛtho yaś ca nisvaraḥ | te te yakṣmaṃ savedaso dūrād dūram acucyavuḥ ||
english: Saṃkasuka, Vikasuka, and Nirṛtha too, and the one who is Nisvara — those of you, O Savedas, have caused disease to reel away, farther and farther.

sanskrit: annāt tvā puruṣebhyo gobhyo aśvebhyas tvā | kravyādaṃ nir ṇudāmasy agniṃ jīvitayopanam ||
english: From food, from men, from cattle, from horses — the flesh-eating fire that undermines life, we push away.

sanskrit: yo no aśveṣu vīreṣu yo goṣu yo ajādiṣu | kravyādaṃ nir ṇudāmasy agnir yo janayopanaḥ ||
english: That which is among our horses, among our heroes, among our cattle, among our goats and sheep — the flesh-eating Agni that undermines the people, we push away.

sanskrit: samiddho agna āhuta sa no mābhyapakramīḥ | atraiva dīdihi dyavi jyok ca sūryāya dṛśe ||
english: O Agni, kindled and fed with oblation, do not depart from us. Shine right here in the sky, and for long be visible to the sun.

sanskrit: yasmin devā amṛjata yasmin manuṣyā uta | tasmin ghṛtastāvo mṛṣṭvā tvam agne divaṃ ruha ||
english: In whom the gods have wiped themselves, and men too — having wiped yourself in him, praised with ghee, O Agni, ascend to heaven.

sanskrit: sīse mṛḍhvaṃ naḍe mṛḍhvam agniḥ saṃkasukaś ca yaḥ | atho avyāṃ rāmāyāṃ śīrṣaktim upabarhaṇe ||
english: Wipe yourself on lead, wipe yourself on reed — and whatever Agni Saṃkasuka there is; also on the dark wool of a sheep, the headache-pillow as its pad.

sanskrit: sīse balaṃ sādayitvā śīrṣaktim upabarhaṇe | avyām asiknyāṃ mṛṣṭvā śuddhā bhavanti yajñiyāḥ ||
english: Having placed the evil force in lead, with the headache as its pad, wiping it on the dark wool of a sheep, they become pure and fit for sacrifice.
